context_for_next_testing_agent: Signature SVG rendering verified at the function level. For visual confirmation, a future agent could trigger a real PDF export from the app (Reports screen -> 'Als PDF teilen') and open the resulting file to confirm the signature now fills the box vertically and sits on the baseline. The CSS rule '.signature-area > svg { width:100% !important; height:100% !important }' guarantees the SVG fills its container. ESLint is broken globally — main agent should fix eslint.config.js if lint is needed later.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: SVG was rendered with fixed width=280px inside a flex container that vertically centered it (align-items:center) with default preserveAspectRatio=xMidYMid meet. On A4 paper the signature column is wider than 280px, so the SVG kept its natural size and looked tiny, plus stroke-width scaled with the SVG. Fix correctly: (1) width=100% to fill the cell, (2) container CSS forces svg to 100%x100%, (3) xMidYMax meet anchors the signature to the bottom (signature 'sits on the line'), (4) vector-effect=non-scaling-stroke keeps stroke width constant regardless of viewBox scaling. Unit test confirms all four properties are present in output.
